observations: The REAL IR engine (ir-rt) holds the spike prototype's promise: create 5.6ms (~1.6x vanilla) with the full pipeline — runtime template parse, IR compile, keyed reconciler, per-key signals, component support.
vs current engine: create ~87x, replace ~253x, partial update ~147x, select ~209x, append ~141x faster. All 8 ops error-free in both engines.
ir-rt swap (1.4ms) pays the pointer-walk without LIS optimization yet; still 2.7x faster than current keyed <for>.

Phase 2 ROADMAP budget check: update/select land within noise of vanilla (sub-ms); create at 1.56x vanilla vs the <=1.4x Phase-2 budget — LIS reconciler and bind-walk tuning are the known remaining levers (Phase 3 target 1.2x).
